'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Afghanistan–Pakistan clashes (2024–present)|Afghanistan–Pakistan clashes]]
**[[2025 Afghanistan–Pakistan conflict]]
***At least 23 [[Pakistan Army|Pakistani soldiers]] and nine [[Afghan Army|Afghan soldiers]] are killed during the ongoing clashes [[Durand Line|at the border]]. [[Pakistan]] claims that it captured 19 Afghan [[Border checkpoint|border posts]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/10/12/taliban-pakistani-forces-trade-heavy-fire-along-afghanistan-border (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2025 Malagasy protests]]
**[[2025 Malagasy mutiny]]
***[[Malagasy President]] [[Andry Rajoelina]] says that an [[Coup d'état|attempted coup]] has been initiated after a group of the [[Madagascar Armed Forces|military]] joined protestors and exchanged gunfire with [[Politics of Madagascar|pro-government]] security forces, demanding Rajoelina to step down. [https://apnews.com/article/madagascar-protests-attempted-coup-e6dd29a429e06362efd238cfac7270d0 (AP)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Societal breakdown in the Gaza Strip during the Gaza war]]
***At least 19 [[Doghmush clan]] members and eight [[Hamas]] fighters are killed in a [[shootout]] in [[Gaza City]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cg5e551j593o (BBC News)]
***[[Palestinians|Palestinian]] journalist [[Saleh al-Jafarawi]] is shot and killed by Doghmush clan members amid shootouts with Hamas in Gaza City. [https://www.trtworld.com/article/34ca89c73006 (TRT World)]
*[[2025 Tehreek-e-Labbaik Pakistan protests]]
**Three protestors, a bystander and a policeman are killed and dozens are injured during clashes in [[Muridke]], [[Pakistan]], as a pro-[[Palestine]] march, organized by the [[Tehreek-e-Labbaik Pakistan|TLP Party]], attempted to reach the [[Embassy of the United States, Islamabad|American embassy]] in [[Islamabad]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/clashes-an-anti-israel-rally-pakistan-kill-five-police-say-2025-10-13/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Pacific typhoon season]]
**More than three people are reported missing and at least 34 others are rescued when remnants of [[Typhoon Halong (2025)|Typhoon Halong]] causes flooding in [[Kipnuk, Alaska|Kipnuk]] and [[Kwigillingok, Alaska|Kwigillingok]], [[Alaska]], United States. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/dozens-rescued-remnants-typhoon-hits-alaska-noreaster-brings-126473399 (ABC News)]
*Forty-two people are killed and 49 others injured in a bus crash in [[Louis Trichardt]], [[Limpopo]], [[South Africa]]. [https://apnews.com/article/south-africa-bus-crash-8e3aabc62a5826f6522ee8cbc6fc7fb4 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Mass shootings in the United States]]
**[[2025 Saint Helena Island shooting]]
***Four people are killed and at least 20 others are injured, including four critically, in a [[mass shooting]] at a crowded bar in [[Saint Helena Island (South Carolina)|Saint Helena Island]], [[South Carolina]], [[United States]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/10/12/us/south-carolina-bar-shooting-sun (CNN)]

'''Politics and elections''' 
*[[2025 Cameroonian presidential election]]
**[[Cameroonians]] vote to elect [[President of Cameroon|their president]], with the incumbent [[Paul Biya]] seeking his eighth term. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/cameroon-holds-presidential-election-biya-seeks-extend-four-decade-iron-grip-2025-10-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[2025 Ecuador protests]]
**[[National Police of Ecuador|Police]] clash with protestors in [[Quito]], [[Ecuador]], amid ongoing demonstrations against [[President of Ecuador|President]] [[Daniel Noboa]] over an increase in fuel price. Noboa has refused to negotiate with the [[Indigenous peoples in Ecuador|Indigenous]] federation, which leads part of the protests against his government. [https://apnews.com/article/daniel-noboa-quito-ecuador-indigenous-1a897be431ca52db8352315d8c8f75f1 (AP)]
*[[2025 Seychellois general election]]
**[[Patrick Herminie]] wins the presidential election in [[Seychelles]] by obtaining more than 52% of the votes, becoming the next [[President of Seychelles]], defeating the incumbent [[Wavel Ramkalawan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/former-speaker-herminie-wins-seychelles-presidential-election-2025-10-12/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2025 ATP Tour]]
**In [[tennis]], [[Monaco|Monégasque]] player [[Valentin Vacherot]], who was ranked 204th on the [[ATP rankings]], defeats his cousin [[Arthur Rinderknech]] in the [[Shanghai Masters (tennis)|Shanghai Masters]] final 4–6, 6–3, 6–3, to become the lowest-ranked [[Masters 1000]] winner in ATP history, and the first from [[Monaco]]. [https://www.espn.com/tennis/story/_/id/46570136/valentin-vacherot-beats-cousin-arthur-rinderknech-win-shanghai-masters (ESPN)] [https://www.atptour.com/en/news/vacherot-first-time-winner-spotlight-shanghai-2025 (ATP Tour)]
**Following his win at the Shanghai Masters, Vacherot moves to rank 40 and becomes the highest ranked Monégasque player in history, surpassing [[Jean-René Lisnard]] who ranked 106th in 2006. [https://www.olympics.com/en/news/shanghai-masters-2025-arthur-rinderknech-valentin-vacherot-all-cousin-final-results (Olympics)]
*[[2025 Supercars Championship]]
**In [[touring car racing]], [[Grove Racing]] drivers [[Matthew Payne]] and [[Garth Tander]] win the [[2025 Bathurst 1000|68th running]] of the [[Supercars Championship|Supercars]] [[Bathurst 1000]].  [https://www.supercars.com/news/supercars-news-2025-results-bathurst-1000-race-report-video-crashes-battle-matt-payne-garth-tander (Supercars)]
